notes:
* Updates:
   * Deadline for Code Freeze and Test Freeze will be in Week 12 Monday 16th November 2026 (AoE) / Tuesday 17th November 2026, which will be next 5 weeks.
   * We will send out the Code Freeze reminder in Week 10 (early November). Since this Code Freeze falls after KubeCon NA (Week 11), we’ll plan for communication a week early in case anything unexpected comes up and everyone can raise exception requests earlier if they need.
   * Release Signal (APAC: [participant]/ [participant], EMEA: [participant]/ [participant]):
   * Current Status: Green
   * kubetest.Timout on sig-release-master-blocking#gce-cos-alphafeatures-master board is flaky, but sig node leadership said it’s not a release blocker for the alpha release, so our current status is now green. ref
What's happened since last week
   * Last week’s branch sync PR has been merged
   * Release Notes for v1.38.0-alpha.1 has been completed and merged
   * 1st and 2nd PR Placeholder reminder for KEP owners has been completed on Github.
   * Release Notes for v1.38.0-alpha.2 has been created and currently waiting review/approval
Important dates & upcoming work
   * We will continue the next outreach (3rd) for Docs Placeholder reminders on Slack
   * Release Notes for v1.38.0-alpha.3 creation: 21st Oct 2026 by [participant] and review by [participant]
   * Next k/website weekly sync: 16th Oct by [participant]
   * Docs Placeholder deadline: Thursday 29 October 2026 (AoE)
                       Total tracked KEPs: 86
   * Missing Placeholder PR:  35 (~40 % remaining)
   * Draft PR: 40
   * PR Ready for Review: 5
   * No Docs Needed: 6
   * Merged: 0
   * Comms (APAC: [participant] / EMEA: [participant]):
   * Current Status: Green
   * Progress Issue
   * First set of outreach to KEPs for feature blogs is complete. Feature Blog freeze is on Wednesday 4th November 2026 (AoE) / Thursday 5th November 2026 12:00 UTC.
   * [participant] has opened up the Release Highlights GitHub Discussion and the internal tracking issue for this. This week we'll start reaching out to SIGs on slack for release highlights. The Release Highlights discussion closes on Tuesday 24th November 2026.
   * Mid cycle blog publication date is on Monday 23rd November 2026. We'll aim to have writeup available as k/website PR a week before for #sig-docs-blog to review. For now we'll be focusing on Feature Blogs and Release Highlights, and will check deprecations and pick highlights for this blog in a couple of weeks.
   * Release Branch Management ([participant] / [participant]):
   * Current Status: Green
   * Progress issue
   * v1.38.0-alpha.2 is live!
   * v1.38.0-alpha.3 is scheduled for next week (October 21st)
   * Subproject Leads ([participant] / [participant], [participant] / [participant]):
   * Missing shadow onboarding session scheduled.
   * Start thinking about succession for your roles!
   * Release Lead ([participant]/ [participant]):
   * All of the action items and progress can be found in https://github.com/kubernetes/sig-release/issues/3087
   * I might not be able to make it to the APAC meeting because of a work event at my office :’)
   * Mid cycle retro scheduled for October 28 (week 9 out of 16)
   * Burndown meetings scheduled on Monday and Friday starting November 23rd
